evidence.title: Nielsen Norman Group: UX Training, Consulting, & Research - NN/G

name: Nielsen Norman Group
summary: UX research articles, training courses and certification, reports and consulting from the Nielsen Norman Group.
description: Nielsen Norman Group publishes evidence-based UX articles and videos, sells live online and self-paced courses with UX Certification, research reports and books, and offers consulting (user research, expert review, usability testing, UX maturity assessment). Aimed at UX practitioners, designers and product teams.
contains: article and video library on UX research, usability and interaction design
live online courses and self-paced courses (priced from US$49 to US$199)
UX Certification: take 5 live courses, pass 5 online exams
consulting: user research, expert review, applied workshops, keynote speaking, user testing, UX maturity assessment
